source_semantics.positions: Historical uppercase RX/RZ are Earth-frame sensor positions. Every saved native sensor body/Earth coordinate pair is checked exactly equal under the declared identity frame; comparisons use position_earth.
source_semantics.airspeed: Source !V sets VIAS (indicated airspeed), not directly true airspeed. Declared rho=rho_SL=1.23 makes native true U=30 m/s equal indicated 30 m/s prospectively. Historical atmospheric settings remain unknown.
source_semantics.angle: Source MATLAB plots absolute Var8=Theta[3], sensor3 Earth-triad elevation. The unused theta2 expression uses matrix right division /, not pointwise ./; it is not treated as a pointwise chord-angle series. The separately calculated atan2 LE/TE chord projection is diagnostic only.

limitations: This is one conditional 5-degree/30 m/s literal-derived model case on three current meshes; no full-curve comparison or experimental validation.
Passing a 0.1% successive-mesh criterion does not establish a global absolute error bound, exact historical NODE I40 equivalence, or full asymptotic convergence.
Displacement refinement changes sign, and the elevation increment is larger on 60-to-120 than on 30-to-60. No asymptotic order or Richardson error estimate is inferred.
Gravity, altitude/atmosphere, PG policy and Earth attitude remain declared reconstruction choices.
Only two load-null out-of-domain Weight records were removed; no legacy resolver or nonzero attachment semantics are established.
There is no historical or experimental agreement passband, stability result, fitted coefficient, or family promotion.
